agent_brief: Site is live and indexed but thin on service pages. No suburb pages at all. Competitors have 40+ location pages each.
headline: You rank on page four for the searches that pay, and page one belongs to three competitors.
intro: Across the fourteen searches that actually generate shower repair enquiries in Brisbane, your average position is 60 and not one of them sits in the top ten. Meanwhile Brisbane Shower Repairs holds an average of 4. Your site is indexed and healthy — it is simply not built to answer the searches people are making.

target_keywords.keyword: leaking shower repair no tile removal

competitors.name: Leak Doctor QLD
competitors.note: Strong review volume and GBP posts

technical_issues.impact: Every 'near me' and suburb-qualified search resolves to your homepage, which cannot rank for thirty different places at once.
technical_issues.evidence: 18 indexed pages, none targeting a Brisbane suburb

technical_issues.issue: Service pages have no unique copy
technical_issues.impact: Three of your service pages share the same 90 words with the category name swapped, so Google treats them as one page and ranks none of them.
Your business hours, service area and reviews are invisible to Google's rich results, which is where the local pack draws from.
technical_issues.evidence: No LocalBusiness schema found on any page

technical_issues.impact: The gallery loads eleven full-size photos before any text renders, and most of your traffic is on a phone standing in a wet bathroom.

projection_note: This trajectory is a projection built from the difficulty and competition of the six keywords above, not a guarantee. Search results are ranked by Google and no agency controls that. What we commit to is the work in each phase, delivered on the dates given.

phases.title: Foundations and cleanup
phases.focus: Fix what is actively blocking the site from ranking before adding anything new to it.
deliverables: Rewrite the three duplicate service pages as distinct, useful pages
Add LocalBusiness and Service structured data across the site
Compress and lazy-load the gallery, cutting homepage weight to under 900 KB
Fix internal linking so service pages are reachable in one click

phases.title: Suburb coverage
phases.focus: Build the pages that answer suburb-qualified searches your homepage currently absorbs.
deliverables: 12 suburb landing pages for the primary areas, each with local job photos
Suburb-specific FAQ blocks answering real enquiry questions
Internal linking hub connecting suburbs to services

phases.title: Authority and reviews
phases.focus: Give Google the trust signals that separate position 6 from position 2.
deliverables: Directory and trade association citations, consistent NAP across all
Review generation flow sending customers to Google after each job
Two long-form guides targeting the informational searches that precede a booking

pricing_tiers.name: Foundation
pricing_tiers.tagline: Fix the site and cover the core suburbs

payment_terms: Monthly in advance. Thirty days notice to cancel, no exit fee.
closing_note: The six keywords above represent about 2,600 searches a month in Brisbane, and you currently appear in the top ten for none of them. The work in phase one takes eight weeks and is what everything else depends on.
disclaimer: Findings are based on publicly available information at the time of writing. Search engine rankings are determined by Google and cannot be guaranteed by any third party. Traffic and position projections are estimates based on keyword difficulty and current competition.
